is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles culicifacies sensu lato (page 1, title and abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotypes the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation (page 1 abstract; page 5 Results).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 5, Results: 'A total of 186 samples were genotyped using AS-PCR, of which 167 were assigned as homozygous susceptible (SS), one as homozygous resistant (RR) and 18 as heterozygote (SR)'.

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes were collected from Surat district of Gujarat state, India (page 2, 'Study area'). No African populations were studied.

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research article reporting novel PCR assays and empirical genotyping of field-collected Anopheles culicifacies.

sub_country_location.evidence: Surat district, Gujarat state, India, within three Primary Health Centres: Amladam, Bareda and Dadheda (page 2, 'Study area').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No sampling dates or collection years are provided in the paper.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field collection from local primary health centres in India for assay development and validation.

supplement.evidence: All genotype data necessary are reported in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study develops three PCR-based methods (AS-PCR, ARMS, and PIRA-PCR) for genotyping the Vgsc L1014F mutation in Anopheles culicifacies s.l. and tests 186 field-collected mosquitoes from Surat district, Gujarat, India. It is ineligible because the mosquitoes are from India, not Africa.
